meta.title: Alumni Community
meta.og_description: Welcome to Imperial's global alumni community — 274,000 graduates strong. Here's where to start.

cover.headline: Welcome to the
cover.body: The knowledge you've gained, the friendships you've built and the challenges you've overcome will stay with you long after you leave campus. You're joining a network of over 274,000 Imperial alumni around the world.
cover.colophon: A welcome from Nicole Kempton, Director of Alumni Engagement — Imperial College London

sections.title: So, where do you start?
sections.intro: Stay in touch. Update your contact details so Imperial can keep you connected to the alumni community — and remember, you'll also need to complete the Graduate Outcomes Survey.

sections.title: Imperial shop
sections.intro: Take home a piece of your graduation with official Imperial merchandise, from academic keepsakes to everyday wear.

accordion_items.title: Lifelong learning
accordion_items.body: Support for further study, mentoring and career development — your learning doesn't stop at graduation.

accordion_items.title: Connections
accordion_items.body: Networks, mentoring and local alumni communities, in London and around the world.

accordion_items.title: Perks
accordion_items.body: Discounts, library access and continued use of Students' Union facilities.

cards.title: Share your graduation photos
cards.body: Post your favourite moment from the day and tag @ImperialCollege.

cards.title: Join the LinkedIn alumni group
cards.body: Connect with fellow graduates building careers across every industry.

cards.title: Follow the alumni Facebook page
cards.body: Keep up with reunions, events and news from the Imperial community.

pull_quote.text: It's our willingness to make a positive contribution to the world and always question the boundaries of what's possible that distinguishes us as a community.

sections.title: Meet your fellow alumni
sections.intro: A handful of the 274,000+ graduates who've walked this same path.

cards.title: Professor Monique Frize
cards.body: Pioneering electrical engineer and ambassador for women in STEM, whose work transformed the safety of hospital equipment.

cards.title: Alistair Kilgour
cards.body: Angel investor who founded Parkwalk Advisors, the largest EIS fund in the UK, investing £500 million in world-leading university spinouts.

cards.title: Dame Maggie Aderin-Pocock
cards.body: Space scientist, business founder and BBC presenter, who helped develop instruments for the James Webb Space Telescope.

cards.title: Tony Shen
cards.body: One of the youngest Fellows of the Royal Aeronautical Society, dedicated to sustainability and gender balance in STEM.

cards.title: Professor Filipe Pereira
cards.body: A pioneering expert in molecular medicine, celebrated for transformative work in cellular reprogramming and cancer immunotherapy.

cards.title: Christopher Hopper
cards.body: CEO and co-founder of Aurora Solar, building AI-powered software for solar panel installations.

cards.title: Professor Phebe Vayanos
cards.body: Training the next generation in trustworthy AI, and helping public service organisations make fairer decisions.

cards.title: Lucy (Soo Min) Jung
cards.body: Design entrepreneur and founder of Charco Neurotech, transforming the lives of people with Parkinson's disease.

cards.title: Dr Shiladitya Ghosh
cards.body: Climate tech expert, COO and co-founder of Mission Zero, building solutions to remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.

cards.title: You!
cards.body: Discover more about the varied careers and achievements of our alumni community.
